newsitem.title: USA: PHLX forex options exempt from CFTC regs.
newsitem.headline: PHLX forex options exempt from CFTC regs.

text.p: Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Wednesday granted a request by Philadelphia Stock Exchange for an exemption from CFTC regulations related to its cross-listing of foreign currency options with the Hong Kong Futures Exchange.

The Philadelphia exchange asked CFTC for exemption from agency rules, saying the cross-listed forex currency options with the Hong Kong exchange would be cleared through a securities-regulated clearing organization.
Regulatory authority over forex currency options is divided between CFTC and Securities and Exchange Commission.

CFTC said in a notice published in the Federal Register that SEC's regulation of registered broker-dealers and clearing organizations would be adequate to oversee the Philadelphia exchange's cross-listings with Hong Kong.
